level.why: 句型多為簡短的第一人稱陳述句，口語自然、容易朗讀，字彙偏日常；但 approachable、outgoing、initiate、contribute 等字與 comfortable with 等表達略需理解。

passage:
Have you ever heard of the word “otrovert”?

I came across it recently, and it actually describes me pretty well.

I’m approachable, but I’m not particularly outgoing. I enjoy connecting with people, but I don’t need to be the center of attention or belong to a particular group.

When I’m with others, I’m happy to listen and share my thoughts when I have something to contribute. But I’m also perfectly fine just staying quiet. I don’t feel the need to fill every silence.

I’m also very comfortable being alone. I can sit in a café by myself, people-watch, or just read a book. I don’t need company to feel comfortable.

I enjoy socializing, but I don’t usually initiate conversations. I can be friendly and open without being particularly outgoing.

That’s why I relate to being an otrovert. I’m independent, comfortable in my own space, and happy connecting with people without feeling the need to fit in.

In the end, I enjoy people’s company, but I’m just as comfortable on my own.
zh:
你聽過「otrovert」這個詞嗎？

我最近剛好看到這個詞，它其實把我形容得相當貼切。

我很容易親近，但並不特別外向。我喜歡與人交流，但不需要成為眾人的焦點，也不需要隸屬於某個特定的圈子。

和別人在一起時，我樂於傾聽，有想法可以貢獻時也會分享自己的看法。但我也完全可以只是安靜地待著。我不覺得非得填滿每一段沉默不可。

我也非常自在地享受獨處。我可以自己坐在咖啡館裡，看看來來往往的路人，或只是讀一本書。我不需要有人陪伴才會覺得自在。

我喜歡社交，但通常不會主動開啟對話。我可以友善而開放，卻不必特別外向。

這就是為什麼我認同自己是個 otrovert。我很獨立，在自己的空間裡感到自在，也樂於與人交流，而不覺得需要刻意融入群體。

總之，我喜歡有人相伴，但自己一個人時也同樣自在。

vocab.zh: 平易近人的、容易親近的

vocab.col: initiate a conversation / initiate a project
contribute ideas / contribute to a discussion

questions.q: What is the speaker mainly doing in the talk?
opts: Recommending places where people can make new friends.
Describing a personality type and explaining why it fits the speaker.
Giving advice on how to become more outgoing.
Comparing different kinds of social groups.
why: 講者並未推薦交友場所，只提到自己可以坐在咖啡館獨處。
正解：講者介紹「otrovert」這個詞，並說明自己為什麼覺得這個詞很貼切地形容了自己。
講者並不想變得更外向，反而說自己不特別外向也很自在。
講者沒有比較不同的社交團體，只說自己不需要隸屬於特定團體。

questions.q: According to the speaker, which statement is true?
opts: The speaker always starts conversations with strangers.
The speaker feels the need to fill every silence.
The speaker prefers to be the center of attention.
The speaker is comfortable staying quiet around other people.
why: 講者說自己通常不會主動開啟對話，所以並非總是主動找陌生人說話。
講者明確表示不覺得需要填滿每一段沉默。
講者說自己不需要成為眾人的焦點。
正解：講者說和別人在一起時，自己完全可以只是安靜地待著。

questions.q: Why does the speaker mention sitting in a café alone?
opts: To show that being by oneself feels comfortable.
To explain why the speaker dislikes crowded places.
To suggest a good place to meet new people.
why: 正解：講者以獨自坐在咖啡館、看人或讀書為例，說明自己不需要有人陪伴也覺得自在。
講者並未說討厭擁擠的地方。
講者沒有建議在咖啡館認識新朋友。
講者說的是享受獨處，並沒有抱怨孤單。

questions.q: Our new manager is highly ______, so employees feel free to ask her questions at any time.
why: approach 是原形動詞或名詞，不能放在 highly 之後作補語。
approaching 是現在分詞，意思是「正在接近的」，語意不符。
正解：空格需要形容詞作 is 的補語，approachable 表示「平易近人的」。
approachably 是副詞，不能作 is 的補語。

questions.q: Participants are asked to speak only ______ they have something useful to add to the discussion.
why: only unless 搭配不合文法，且語意會變成相反。
正解：only when 表示「只有在……的時候」，引導完整子句，語意正確。
although 表示「雖然」，語意不通順。
during 後面須接名詞，不能接完整子句。

questions.q: Mr. Park prefers to work ______, without needing close supervision from his supervisor.
why: independence 是名詞，不能修飾動詞 work。
independent 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 work。
independents 是名詞複數，詞性不符。
正解：空格需要副詞修飾動詞 work，independently 表示「獨立地」。

presentation_phrases.usage: 說明自己如何接觸到某個概念，並連結到個人經驗

presentation_phrases.phrase: I enjoy connecting with people, but I don’t need to ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我喜歡與人交流，但我不需要……

presentation_phrases.phrase: I’m happy to listen and share my thoughts when I have something to contribute.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我樂於傾聽，有可以貢獻的想法時也會分享。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明自己在討論或交談中的參與方式

presentation_phrases.phrase: I don’t feel the need to fill every silence.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我不覺得需要填滿每一段沉默。
presentation_phrases.usage: 小型交談中表達自己對安靜與冷場的態度

presentation_phrases.meaning: 我通常不會主動開啟對話。
presentation_phrases.usage: 描述自己在社交場合的習慣，語氣平實不失禮
說明自己與某個概念或觀點產生共鳴的原因

presentation_phrases.phrase: In the end, I enjoy ..., but I’m just as comfortable ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 總之，我喜歡……，但也同樣自在於……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於結尾，以前後對照的句型總結全篇重點
